gloss: with all one's might; to one's heart's content

definitions.gloss: with all one's might; as hard as possible
definitions.explanation: doing something with maximum effort or force
doing something fully without holding back

examples.japanese: {思|おも}い{切|き}り{叫|さけ}んだ。
examples.english: I shouted with all my might.

examples.japanese: ボールを{思|おも}い{切|き}り{投|な}げた。
examples.english: I threw the ball as hard as I could.

examples.japanese: {思|おも}い{切|き}り{楽|たの}しんだ。
examples.english: I enjoyed myself to my heart's content.

examples.japanese: {休日|きゅうじつ}は{思|おも}い{切|き}り{寝|ね}たい。
examples.english: On my day off, I want to sleep as much as I like.

examples.japanese: {思|おも}い{切|き}り{泣|な}いてスッキリした。
examples.english: I cried my heart out and felt relieved.

examples.japanese: {思|おも}い{切|き}りジャンプした。
examples.english: I jumped with all my might.

notes:
USAGE:
Can modify both physical actions (with full force) and emotional/experiential activities (without restraint).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {思|おも}い{切|き}り{遊|あそ}ぶ - to play to one's heart's content
- {思|おも}い{切|き}り{笑|わら}う - to laugh heartily
- {思|おも}い{切|き}り{走|はし}る - to run with all one's might
- {思|おも}い{切|き}り{泣|な}く - to cry one's heart out

RELATED WORD:
- {思|おも}い{切|き}る (verb) - to make up one's mind; to give up

NUANCE:
Implies abandoning restraint or reservation.
